title: Opening an ice cream parlor and buying a saloon at Sixth and Rampart
summary: At 17 he opened an ice cream parlor on Rampart Street, hired Myknee Jones on piano, and bought a saloon he was too young to enter.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: What part of town did you...

That was 6th and Rampart, Rounds, that's where I stayed after most of my time, and after that I grew up, and after I got up in age, I was 17 years old, and I went in business. I opened in New Orleans Ice Cream Paula at 6th and Rampart across from Bazee's Saloon, see. And I was on Rampart Street, two-story building, and Bazeele was right on the corner. Well, after I stayed there a little while, I made such a good business there, until Roy Palmer got in connection with me. And I told him, I said, well, I don't know about playing music, but I had a piano in the place, and I had met Miney Jones, and Miney Jones used to come that night and play, and I used to give him $1.75, something like that, to play, see. Well, after that got to going so good, then I bought the saloon from Smith's at Fulton Rampart. He went to Los Angeles and sold the saloon to me. I even had a saloon and couldn't go in it.
